content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to use Visual Basic to read log files from a [company_name] [product_name] device?
From what I know, that's not possible. I've never heard of directly reading the log memory except when using [product_name] software.
Thank you for the information. Is it possible to display log file values on a webpage hosted by the internal web server?

No, that's not possible, either. The only known software for reading Data Logs from the SD card is [product_name] software. However, with the [product_name] Access Tool, you can read variables directly into MS Excel.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for methods to programmatically retrieve log data from [company_name] [product_name] devices or show it through a web interface, but discover that available options are very limited. Reading logs via Visual Basic or displaying them on an internal webserver is not achievable, aside from official tools provided by [company_name]. The conversation points out restricted third-party support for accessing or visualizing historical data.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to access [product_name] log files programmatically and display them on the web or through custom applications, without relying solely on official software solutions.
